nom: ANUA Triple Acid Spot Care Microdart Patch

avis.titre: Fell off after less than a minute
avis.texte: I tried this patch for a cyst on my jawline twice. The first time, I could not get it to adhere. The second attempt fell off my face in under a minute. I walked from one room to the next and it was gone (no idea where because it's clear so I really hope my cat doesn't find it first). Also, the design is terrible. The white sticker is easy to get off, but the clear layer is very difficult to take off. Plus, the spikey part is exposed so you inevitably have to touch it to get the patch free so it gets dirty before sticking the micro darts into your skin.

I wish I knew the entire patch is not adhesive; there is a tiny strip around the circumference that's sticky. It's incredibly difficult to peel the circular strip off without getting the patch stuck to itself. Also, they fail to stay on for long.

avis.titre: Awesome for cystic acne or cysts
avis.texte: This is my third night consecutively of trying these, im almost out but ordering more. These are worth every penny in comparison to others in the market.

avis.titre: Will be buying more when I run out !
avis.texte: I usually use the peach and lily microdot patches but these ones are so much better! Super easy to apply and they decrease redness and swelling of thoes subborn acne spots !! Love these patches ! They really work great !

Finally a spot patch that is medicated for inflamed breakouts. The microdarts actually feel like the acid is getting deep into the blemish. My new go to for stuborn spots, definitely stocking up on these.
